description: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers of a model, comparing the state before gating, after gating, and a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 20 and is plotted on a linear scale with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4 and is also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at approximately 0.05, remains relatively low and fluctuates between roughly 0.1 and 0.5 until layer 20, then sharply increases to about 4.3; an orange dotted line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean after gate," which stays consistently near 0.05 across all layers; and a green solid line with circular markers for the "hidden state mean of baseline," which remains near 0.04 across all layers. The caption notes that the baseline and post-gating values are similar, which is visually supported by the near-identical, low, flat trajectories of the orange and green lines.
